result.title: Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
result.summary: Alignment of text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions is a key challenge in controllable generation. Existing approaches typically rely on optimizing model inputs or fine-tuning denoising networks, which requires computationally expensive backpropagation through large denoising models. In this work, we propose Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that performs alignment by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory of diffusion models. Specifically, DTO treats intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as the optimization variables, eliminating the need for gradients through the denoising network. To mitigate the out-of-distribution problem, we introduce Reward-Optimized Score Guidance, which interpolates between the optimized scores and the pretrained model predictions to stabilize sampling, while providing a provable theoretical guarantee of reward improvement under constrained distributions. Empirically, DTO improves alignment performance across three diffusion models on two benchmarks, outperforming existing inference-time alignment methods while maintaining high efficiency. These results suggest that trajectory-level optimization is a promising direction for efficient and effective diffusion model alignment.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 Direct Trajectory Optimization（DTO），一种免训练的文生图扩散模型对齐框架：把采样过程中的中间去噪分数与采样噪声作为优化变量直接优化，避免对去噪网络反向传播，并用 Reward-Optimized Score Guidance 在优化分数与预训练预测之间插值以缓解分布外问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把采样轨迹上的中间状态当作可优化变量、用奖励信号在推理期直接调整」的思路，可能为 LVR 中测试时 latent 状态轨迹的奖励驱动优化与偏离分布时的插值约束提供概念参考；但研究对象是图像生成对齐，与多模态推理状态的具体联系尚需核查。
